import 'dart:convert';

/// Legacy book reference model used in [AgentModel].
class BookModel {
  final String title;
  final String titleArabic;
  final String author;
  final String description;
  final String? url;

  BookModel({
    required this.title,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.author,
    required this.description,
    this.url,
  });
}

/// Raw imported canonical catalog entry from dataset (e.g. canonical_syafii.json).
/// Preserves raw bibliographical fields without premature editorial assumptions.
class CanonicalEntry {
  const CanonicalEntry({
    required this.legacyKey,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.shortTitleArabic,
    required this.authorArabic,
    required this.authorFull,
    required this.recordedDeathYearHijri,
    required this.eraCode,
    required this.textTypeCode,
    required this.recordedAuthorityRank,
    required this.recordedVolumes,
    required this.publisher,
    required this.muhaqqiq,
    required this.raw,
  });

  final String legacyKey;
  final String titleArabic, shortTitleArabic, authorArabic, authorFull;
  final int? recordedDeathYearHijri;
  final String? eraCode, textTypeCode;
  final int? recordedAuthorityRank, recordedVolumes;
  final String? publisher, muhaqqiq;
  final Map<String, dynamic> raw;

  factory CanonicalEntry.fromLegacy(
    String key,
    Map<String, dynamic> row,
  ) {
    String? text(String name) {
      final value = row[name];
      if (value == null) return null;
      if (value is! String) {
        throw FormatException('$key: $name harus berupa teks');
      }
      final clean = value.trim();
      return clean.isEmpty ? null : clean;
    }

    String requiredText(String name) {
      final value = text(name);
      if (value == null) throw FormatException('$key: $name kosong');
      return value;
    }

    int? integer(String name) {
      final value = row[name];
      if (value == null || value == '') return null;
      if (value is! int || value < 0) {
        throw FormatException('$key: $name harus integer nonnegatif');
      }
      return value;
    }

    return CanonicalEntry(
      legacyKey: key,
      titleArabic: requiredText('full_title'),
      shortTitleArabic: requiredText('canonical_short_title'),
      authorArabic: requiredText('author_canonical'),
      authorFull: requiredText('author_full'),
      recordedDeathYearHijri: integer('death_year_hijri'),
      eraCode: text('era'),
      textTypeCode: text('text_type'),
      recordedAuthorityRank: integer('authority_rank'),
      recordedVolumes: integer('volumes_count'),
      publisher: text('publisher'),
      muhaqqiq: text('muhaqqiq'),
      raw: Map<String, dynamic>.unmodifiable(row),
    );
  }
}

class CanonicalImport {
  const CanonicalImport(this.entries, this.issues);
  final List<CanonicalEntry> entries;
  final List<String> issues; // Internal validation log; bukan copy publik.
}

CanonicalImport parseCanonicalCatalog(String source) {
  final root = jsonDecode(source);
  if (root is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
    throw const FormatException('Root katalog harus object JSON');
  }
  final entries = <CanonicalEntry>[];
  final issues = <String>[];
  for (final item in root.entries) {
    try {
      final row = item.value;
      if (row is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
        throw FormatException('${item.key}: entri bukan object');
      }
      entries.add(CanonicalEntry.fromLegacy(item.key, row));
    } on FormatException catch (error) {
      issues.add(error.message.toString());
    }
  }
  return CanonicalImport(
    List<CanonicalEntry>.unmodifiable(entries),
    List<String>.unmodifiable(issues),
  );
}

List<CanonicalBookPresentation> parseSyamilahCatalog(String source) {
  final dynamic root = jsonDecode(source);
  if (root is List) {
    return root
        .whereType<Map<String, dynamic>>()
        .map((item) => CanonicalBookPresentation.fromSyamilahCard(item))
        .toList();
  } else if (root is Map<String, dynamic>) {
    final legacy = parseCanonicalCatalog(source);
    return legacy.entries.map((e) => CanonicalBookPresentation.fromEntry(e)).toList();
  }
  return [];
}

/// Presentation model for catalog books reviewed for display.
/// Prevents UI widgets from turning unverified authority ranks into scientific claims.
class CanonicalBookPresentation {
  const CanonicalBookPresentation({
    required this.editionId,
    required this.titleArabic,
    required this.authorArabic,
    this.shortTitleArabic,
    this.sectionArabic,
    this.titleLatin,
    this.authorLatin,
    this.verifiedDeathYearHijri,
    this.reviewedTypeLabel,
    this.reviewedEraLabel,
    this.reviewedAuthorityLabel,
    this.authorityEvidence,
    this.publisher,
    this.muhaqqiq,
    this.printYear,
    this.volumesDescription,
    this.volumesCount,
    this.pagesDescription,
  });

  final String editionId, titleArabic, authorArabic;
  final String? shortTitleArabic;
  final String? sectionArabic;
  final String? titleLatin, authorLatin;
  final int? verifiedDeathYearHijri;
  final String? reviewedTypeLabel, reviewedEraLabel;
  final String? reviewedAuthorityLabel, authorityEvidence;
  final String? publisher, muhaqqiq;
  final String? printYear;
  final String? volumesDescription;
  final int? volumesCount;
  final String? pagesDescription;

  List<String> get compactLabels => [
        if (sectionArabic != null && sectionArabic!.isNotEmpty) sectionArabic!,
        if (volumesDescription != null && volumesDescription!.isNotEmpty)
          (volumesDescription!.contains('جزء') || volumesDescription!.contains('مجلد') || volumesDescription!.contains('Jilid')
              ? volumesDescription!
              : '$volumesDescription Jilid')
        else if (volumesCount != null && volumesCount! > 1)
          '$volumesCount Jilid',
        if (pagesDescription != null && pagesDescription!.isNotEmpty && pagesDescription != '-')
          '$pagesDescription Hlm',
        if (verifiedDeathYearHijri != null && verifiedDeathYearHijri! > 0)
          'ت $verifiedDeathYearHijri هـ',
        if (reviewedTypeLabel != null) reviewedTypeLabel!,
        if (reviewedEraLabel != null) reviewedEraLabel!,
      ].where((l) => l.isNotEmpty).toList();

  bool get canShowAuthority =>
      reviewedAuthorityLabel?.isNotEmpty == true &&
      authorityEvidence?.isNotEmpty == true;

  factory CanonicalBookPresentation.fromSyamilahCard(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final rawDeath = json['tahun_wafat'];
    int? deathYear;
    if (rawDeath is int) {
      deathYear = rawDeath;
    } else if (rawDeath is String) {
      deathYear = int.tryParse(rawDeath);
    }

    String? clean(dynamic v) {
      if (v == null) return null;
      final s = v.toString().trim();
      return (s.isEmpty || s == '-') ? null : s;
    }

    final rawVolumes = clean(json['عدد_الأجزاء']);
    int? volCount;
    if (rawVolumes != null) {
      final match = RegExp(r'^\d+').firstMatch(rawVolumes);
      if (match != null) {
        volCount = int.tryParse(match.group(0)!);
      }
    }

    final rawPages = clean(json['عدد_الصفحات']);
    final fullTitle = (json['الكتاب'] ?? json['full_title'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final shortTitle = clean(json['الاسم_المختصر'] ?? json['canonical_short_title']);
    final author = (json['المؤلف'] ?? json['author_canonical'] ?? json['author_full'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final section = clean(json['القسم']);
    final publisher = clean(json['الناشر'] ?? json['publisher']);
    final muhaqqiq = clean(json['المحقق_أو_المعتني'] ?? json['muhaqqiq']);
    final printYear = clean(json['سنة_الطبع_والطبعة'] ?? json['سنة_الطبع']);
    final id = json['id']?.toString() ?? json['edition_id']?.toString() ?? '1';

    return CanonicalBookPresentation(
      editionId: id,
      titleArabic: fullTitle.isNotEmpty ? fullTitle : (shortTitle ?? 'بدون عنوان'),
      shortTitleArabic: shortTitle,
      authorArabic: author.isNotEmpty ? author : 'غير معروف',
      sectionArabic: section,
      verifiedDeathYearHijri: deathYear,
      publisher: publisher,
      muhaqqiq: muhaqqiq,
      printYear: printYear,
      volumesDescription: rawVolumes,
      volumesCount: volCount,
      pagesDescription: rawPages,
    );
  }

  factory CanonicalBookPresentation.fromEntry(CanonicalEntry entry) {
    String? typeLabel;
    if (entry.textTypeCode != null) {
      switch (entry.textTypeCode) {
        case 'asl_al_madhhab':
          typeLabel = 'Asal Mazhab';
          break;
        case 'matn':
          typeLabel = 'Matan';
          break;
        case 'sharh':
          typeLabel = 'Syarah';
          break;
        case 'hashiyah':
          typeLabel = 'Hasyiyah';
          break;
        case 'khilafiyyat':
          typeLabel = 'Khilafiyyah';
          break;
        case 'fatawa':
          typeLabel = 'Fatwa';
          break;
        case 'ajwibah':
          typeLabel = 'Ajwibah';
          break;
        case 'qawaid':
          typeLabel = 'Qawa\'id';
          break;
        default:
          typeLabel = entry.textTypeCode!.replaceAll('_', ' ');
      }
    }

    String? eraLabel;
    if (entry.eraCode != null) {
      switch (entry.eraCode) {
        case 'mutaqaddimin':
          eraLabel = 'Mutaqaddimin';
          break;
        case 'ashab_al_wujuh':
          eraLabel = 'Ashab Al-Wujuh';
          break;
        case 'mutaakhkhirin':
          eraLabel = 'Muta\'akhkhirin';
          break;
        default:
          eraLabel = entry.eraCode!.replaceAll('_', ' ');
      }
    } else if (entry.recordedDeathYearHijri != null) {
      final y = entry.recordedDeathYearHijri!;
      if (y <= 505) {
        eraLabel = 'Mutaqaddimin';
      } else {
        eraLabel = 'Muta\'akhkhirin';
      }
    }

    return CanonicalBookPresentation(
      editionId: entry.legacyKey,
      titleArabic: entry.titleArabic,
      authorArabic: entry.authorArabic,
      titleLatin: null,
      authorLatin: null,
      verifiedDeathYearHijri: entry.recordedDeathYearHijri,
      reviewedTypeLabel: typeLabel,
      reviewedEraLabel: eraLabel,
      reviewedAuthorityLabel: null, // Held until editorial consensus
      authorityEvidence: null,
      publisher: entry.publisher,
      muhaqqiq: entry.muhaqqiq,
      volumesCount: entry.recordedVolumes,
    );
  }
}

enum BookmarkDocumentKind { personalNote, aiAnswer, bookReference }

enum BookmarkVerificationStatus {
  notApplicable,
  unverified,
  needsReview,
  verified
}

class BookmarkModel {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String agentId;
  final String agentTitle;
  final String fieldName;
  final String fieldId;
  final String arabicExcerpt;
  final String fullAnswer;
  final String bookReference;
  final String pageNumber;
  final String? author;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final DateTime? updatedAt;
  /// Tombstone for conflict-safe offline deletion. It is synchronized so an
  /// older device cannot resurrect a note that was deliberately removed.
  final DateTime? deletedAt;
  final BookmarkDocumentKind documentKind;
  final BookmarkVerificationStatus verificationStatus;

  BookmarkModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.agentId,
    required this.agentTitle,
    required this.fieldName,
    required this.fieldId,
    required this.arabicExcerpt,
    required this.fullAnswer,
    required this.bookReference,
    required this.pageNumber,
    this.author,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.updatedAt,
    this.deletedAt,
    this.documentKind = BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer,
    this.verificationStatus = BookmarkVerificationStatus.unverified,
  });

  DateTime get effectiveTime => updatedAt ?? createdAt;
  DateTime get syncTime => deletedAt ?? effectiveTime;
  bool get isDeleted => deletedAt != null;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'id': id,
      'title': title,
      'agentId': agentId,
      'agentTitle': agentTitle,
      'fieldName': fieldName,
      'fieldId': fieldId,
      'arabicExcerpt': arabicExcerpt,
      'fullAnswer': fullAnswer,
      'bookReference': bookReference,
      'pageNumber': pageNumber,
      'author': author,
      'createdAt': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      'updatedAt': (updatedAt ?? createdAt).toIso8601String(),
      'deletedAt': deletedAt?.toIso8601String(),
      'documentKind': documentKind.name,
      'verificationStatus': verificationStatus.name,
    };
  }

  factory BookmarkModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final id = json['id'] as String? ?? '';
    final agentId = json['agentId'] as String? ?? '';
    final fieldName = json['fieldName'] as String? ?? '';
    final kind = _documentKindFromJson(
      json['documentKind'] as String?,
      id: id,
      agentId: agentId,
      fieldName: fieldName,
    );
    return BookmarkModel(
      id: id,
      title: json['title'] as String? ?? '',
      agentId: agentId,
      agentTitle: json['agentTitle'] as String? ?? '',
      fieldName: fieldName,
      fieldId: json['fieldId'] as String? ?? 'fiqh',
      arabicExcerpt: json['arabicExcerpt'] as String? ?? '',
      fullAnswer: json['fullAnswer'] as String? ?? '',
      bookReference: json['bookReference'] as String? ?? '',
      pageNumber: json['pageNumber'] as String? ?? '',
      author: json['author'] as String?,
      createdAt: json['createdAt'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['createdAt'] as String) ?? DateTime.now()
          : DateTime.now(),
      updatedAt: json['updatedAt'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['updatedAt'] as String)
          : null,
      deletedAt: json['deletedAt'] != null
          ? DateTime.tryParse(json['deletedAt'] as String)
          : null,
      documentKind: kind,
      verificationStatus: _verificationStatusFromJson(
        json['verificationStatus'] as String?,
        kind,
      ),
    );
  }

  BookmarkModel copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? title,
    String? agentId,
    String? agentTitle,
    String? fieldName,
    String? fieldId,
    String? arabicExcerpt,
    String? fullAnswer,
    String? bookReference,
    String? pageNumber,
    String? author,
    DateTime? createdAt,
    DateTime? updatedAt,
    DateTime? deletedAt,
    BookmarkDocumentKind? documentKind,
    BookmarkVerificationStatus? verificationStatus,
  }) {
    return BookmarkModel(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      title: title ?? this.title,
      agentId: agentId ?? this.agentId,
      agentTitle: agentTitle ?? this.agentTitle,
      fieldName: fieldName ?? this.fieldName,
      fieldId: fieldId ?? this.fieldId,
      arabicExcerpt: arabicExcerpt ?? this.arabicExcerpt,
      fullAnswer: fullAnswer ?? this.fullAnswer,
      bookReference: bookReference ?? this.bookReference,
      pageNumber: pageNumber ?? this.pageNumber,
      author: author ?? this.author,
      createdAt: createdAt ?? this.createdAt,
      updatedAt: updatedAt ?? this.updatedAt,
      deletedAt: deletedAt ?? this.deletedAt,
      documentKind: documentKind ?? this.documentKind,
      verificationStatus: verificationStatus ?? this.verificationStatus,
    );
  }

  static BookmarkDocumentKind _documentKindFromJson(
    String? value, {
    required String id,
    required String agentId,
    required String fieldName,
  }) {
    return BookmarkDocumentKind.values.firstWhere(
      (kind) => kind.name == value,
      orElse: () {
        if (id.startsWith('book_') ||
            fieldName.toLowerCase().contains('rujukan kitab')) {
          return BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference;
        }
        if (agentId == 'catatan_mandiri' ||
            fieldName.toLowerCase().contains('catatan pribadi')) {
          return BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote;
        }
        return BookmarkDocumentKind.aiAnswer;
      },
    );
  }

  static BookmarkVerificationStatus _verificationStatusFromJson(
    String? value,
    BookmarkDocumentKind kind,
  ) {
    return BookmarkVerificationStatus.values.firstWhere(
      (status) => status.name == value,
      orElse: () => kind == BookmarkDocumentKind.personalNote
          ? BookmarkVerificationStatus.notApplicable
          : kind == BookmarkDocumentKind.bookReference
              ? BookmarkVerificationStatus.needsReview
              : BookmarkVerificationStatus.unverified,
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

/// Model data kanonikal untuk representasi naskah/kitab dalam katalog OpenTurath.
class OpenTurathBook {
  const OpenTurathBook({
    required this.id,
    required this.deathYear,
    required this.section,
    required this.shortName,
    required this.title,
    required this.author,
    required this.editor,
    required this.publisher,
    required this.edition,
    required this.volumes,
    required this.sourceFolder,
    required this.pages,
  });

  final int id;
  final int? deathYear;
  final String section;
  final String shortName;
  final String title;
  final String author;
  final String editor;
  final String publisher;
  final String edition;
  final String volumes;
  final String sourceFolder;
  final String pages;

  factory OpenTurathBook.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return OpenTurathBook(
      id: _intValue(json['id']),
      deathYear: _nullableInt(json['tahun_wafat']),
      section: _textValue(json['القسم'] ?? json['section'] ?? json['kategori']),
      shortName: _textValue(json['الاسم_المختصر'] ?? json['short_name']),
      title: _textValue(json['الكتاب'] ?? json['title'] ?? json['nama_kitab']),
      author: _textValue(json['المؤلف'] ?? json['author'] ?? json['pengarang']),
      editor: _textValue(json['المحقق_أو_المعتني'] ?? json['editor'] ?? json['tahqiq']),
      publisher: _textValue(json['الناشر'] ?? json['publisher'] ?? json['penerbit']),
      edition: _textValue(json['سنة_الطبع_والطبعة'] ?? json['edition'] ?? json['cetakan']),
      volumes: _textValue(json['عدد_الأجزاء'] ?? json['volumes'] ?? json['jilid']),
      sourceFolder: _textValue(json['folder_sumber'] ?? json['source_folder']),
      pages: _textValue(json['عدد_الصفحات'] ?? json['pages'] ?? json['halaman']),
    );
  }

  static List<OpenTurathBook> decodeList(String source) {
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(source);
      if (decoded is! List) return const [];

      return decoded
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map(
            (item) => OpenTurathBook.fromJson(
              Map<String, dynamic>.from(item),
            ),
          )
          .toList(growable: false);
    } catch (_) {
      return const [];
    }
  }

  static int _intValue(dynamic value) {
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.round();
    final cleaned = value?.toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '') ?? '';
    return int.tryParse(cleaned) ?? 0;
  }

  static int? _nullableInt(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is num) return value.round();
    final cleaned = value.toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
    return int.tryParse(cleaned);
  }

  static String _textValue(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return '';
    return value.toString().trim();
  }

  String get volumeLabel {
    if (volumes.isEmpty || volumes == '-') return 'Jumlah jilid belum tersedia';
    return '$volumes jilid';
  }

  String get deathLabel {
    if (deathYear == null) return 'Tahun wafat belum tersedia';
    return 'W. $deathYear H';
  }

  String get pagesLabel {
    if (pages.isEmpty || pages == '-') return 'Jumlah halaman belum tercatat';
    return '$pages hlm.';
  }
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import '../core/constants.dart';
import '../core/entitlement_keys.dart';

/// Model Hak Akses Per Modul Notebook / Kitab (Canonical Entitlement)
class ModuleEntitlement {
  final String plan;
  final DateTime? expiry;
  final String status; // 'active', 'expired', 'trial'
  final String? sourceTransactionId;
  final DateTime? updatedAt;
  final DateTime? startedAt;
  final int? trialDurationDays;
  final String paymentStatus;

  const ModuleEntitlement({
    required this.plan,
    this.expiry,
    this.status = 'active',
    this.sourceTransactionId,
    this.updatedAt,
    this.startedAt,
    this.trialDurationDays,
    this.paymentStatus = 'none',
  });

  bool get isPremium => RegExp(
          r'^(trial|tholib(?:_1m|_6m)?|bahits(?:_1y)?|premium|all_access|all_ai.*|single|sultan|pro|voucher(?:_.*)?|redeem(?:_.*)?|custom|full)$')
      .hasMatch(plan);

  bool get isActive =>
      status != 'revoked' &&
      status != 'expired' &&
      expiry != null &&
      expiry!.isAfter(DateTime.now());

  factory ModuleEntitlement.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return ModuleEntitlement(
      plan: map['plan'] ?? AppConstants.planTrial,
      expiry: map['expiry'] != null
          ? (map['expiry'] is Timestamp
              ? (map['expiry'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime.tryParse(map['expiry'].toString()))
          : null,
      status: map['status'] ?? 'active',
      sourceTransactionId: map['source_transaction_id'] ?? map['trx_id'],
      updatedAt: map['updated_at'] != null
          ? (map['updated_at'] is Timestamp
              ? (map['updated_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime.tryParse(map['updated_at'].toString()))
          : null,
      startedAt: map['started_at'] != null
          ? (map['started_at'] is Timestamp
              ? (map['started_at'] as Timestamp).toDate()
              : DateTime.tryParse(map['started_at'].toString()))
          : null,
      trialDurationDays: map['trial_duration_days'] as int?,
      paymentStatus: map['payment_status'] ?? 'none',
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'plan': plan,
        'expiry': expiry != null ? Timestamp.fromDate(expiry!) : null,
        'status': status,
        'source_transaction_id': sourceTransactionId,
        'updated_at': updatedAt != null ? Timestamp.fromDate(updatedAt!) : null,
        'started_at': startedAt != null ? Timestamp.fromDate(startedAt!) : null,
        'trial_duration_days': trialDurationDays,
        'payment_status': paymentStatus,
      };

  Map<String, dynamic> toJsonMap() => {
        'plan': plan,
        'expiry': expiry?.toIso8601String(),
        'status': status,
        'source_transaction_id': sourceTransactionId,
        'updated_at': updatedAt?.toIso8601String(),
        'started_at': startedAt?.toIso8601String(),
        'trial_duration_days': trialDurationDays,
        'payment_status': paymentStatus,
      };
}

class UserModel {
  final String uid;
  final String name;
  final String email;
  final String photoUrl;
  final String plan; // Legacy global plan fallback
  final int questionsUsed;
  final DateTime? subscriptionExpiry; // Legacy global expiry fallback
  final Map<String, ModuleEntitlement> entitlements;

  UserModel({
    required this.uid,
    required this.name,
    required this.email,
    required this.photoUrl,
    required this.plan,
    required this.questionsUsed,
    this.subscriptionExpiry,
    this.entitlements = const {},
  });

  // ── Global Legacy Helpers ──
  bool get isTrial => plan == AppConstants.planTrial || plan == 'trial';
  bool get isGuest => email.isEmpty || uid.startsWith('guest_');
  bool get isPremium =>
      plan != 'free' &&
      (plan == AppConstants.planTholib1m ||
          plan == AppConstants.planTholib6m ||
          plan == AppConstants.planBahits1y ||
          plan == 'tholib' ||
          plan == 'bahits' ||
          plan == 'all_ai_1m' ||
          plan == 'all_ai_6m' ||
          plan == 'all_ai_1y' ||
          plan == 'all_access' ||
          plan == 'all_ai' ||
          plan == 'full' ||
          plan == 'sultan' ||
          plan == 'pro' ||
          plan == 'premium' ||
          plan.startsWith('all_ai') ||
          plan.startsWith('redeem') ||
          plan.startsWith('voucher') ||
          plan == 'custom' ||
          (subscriptionExpiry != null &&
              subscriptionExpiry!.isAfter(DateTime.now())));

  /// Voucher trial dan paket berbayar memakai sumber masa berlaku yang sama.
  /// Jangan pernah menjadikan nama paket sebagai alasan menolak masa berlaku
  /// yang masih aktif dari server.
  bool get isSubscriptionActive =>
      subscriptionExpiry != null && subscriptionExpiry!.isAfter(DateTime.now());

  /// Trial is an entitlement with an expiry supplied by the server voucher.
  /// A local question counter must never grant or revoke access.
  bool get hasAccess => isSubscriptionActive ||
      entitlements.values.any((entitlement) =>
          entitlement.isActive && entitlement.isPremium);

  /// Retained for legacy presentation only. Questions are no longer a quota.
  int get questionsRemaining => hasAccess ? 9999 : 0;

  bool get isTrialExhausted => false;

  // ── Modular Entitlement Helpers ──
  ModuleEntitlement? getEntitlement(String agentId) =>
      entitlements[entitlementKeys[agentId] ?? agentId];

  bool isAgentSubscriptionActive(String agentId) {
    final mappedKey = entitlementKeys[agentId] ?? agentId;

    // 1. Specific module entitlement check FIRST
    final specific = entitlements[mappedKey];
    if (specific != null && specific.isActive && specific.isPremium) {
      return true;
    }

    // 2. Explicit all_access entitlement
    final all = entitlements['all_access'] ?? entitlements['all_ai'];
    if (all != null && all.isActive && all.isPremium) {
      return true;
    }

    // If a specific module entitlement was explicitly revoked, deny access
    if (specific != null && specific.status == 'revoked') {
      return false;
    }

    // If an explicit all_access was REVOKED and no active specific entitlement, deny access
    if (all != null && all.status == 'revoked') {
      return false;
    }

    // 3. Explicit global all-access plan check (ONLY truly global all-access plans)
    const globalAllPlans = [
      'all_access',
      'all_ai_1m',
      'all_ai_6m',
      'all_ai_1y',
      'all_ai',
      'full',
      'sultan',
    ];
    final isGlobalPlan = (globalAllPlans.contains(plan) ||
            plan.startsWith('all_ai')) &&
        isSubscriptionActive;
    if (isGlobalPlan) {
      return true;
    }

    // 4. Module-specific plan matching (e.g. 'fiqh_syafii_1m', 'fiqh_tahawwulat_1m')
    if (isSubscriptionActive) {
      final cleanPlan = plan.toLowerCase();
      final cleanKey = mappedKey.toLowerCase();
      if (cleanPlan == cleanKey ||
          cleanPlan.startsWith('${cleanKey}_') ||
          cleanPlan.contains(cleanKey)) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    // 5. Legacy plan backward-compatibility (ONLY when entitlements is empty)
    // When a user has modular entitlements, legacy fallback must never leak unpurchased modules.
    if (entitlements.isEmpty && isSubscriptionActive) {
      const legacyAllAccessPlans = [
        AppConstants.planTholib1m,
        AppConstants.planTholib6m,
        AppConstants.planBahits1y,
      ];
      if (legacyAllAccessPlans.contains(plan) ||
          plan.startsWith('redeem') ||
          plan.startsWith('voucher')) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  bool hasAccessToAgent(String agentId) {
    // Akses notebook memerlukan hak akses langganan atau voucher aktif spesifik modul
    return isAgentSubscriptionActive(agentId);
  }

  int questionsRemainingForAgent(String agentId) {
    if (isAgentSubscriptionActive(agentId)) return 9999;
    return 0;
  }

  factory UserModel.fromMap(String uid, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    // Parse entitlements map
    final Map<String, ModuleEntitlement> parsedEntitlements = {};
    if (data['entitlements'] != null && data['entitlements'] is Map) {
      final rawMap = data['entitlements'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
      rawMap.forEach((key, val) {
        if (val is Map<String, dynamic>) {
          parsedEntitlements[key] = ModuleEntitlement.fromMap(val);
        }
      });
    }

    DateTime? expiry;
    if (data['subscription_expiry'] != null) {
      final exp = data['subscription_expiry'];
      if (exp is Timestamp) {
        expiry = exp.toDate();
      } else if (exp is String) {
        expiry = DateTime.tryParse(exp);
      } else if (exp is int) {
        expiry = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(exp);
      }
    }

    return UserModel(
      uid: uid,
      name: data['name'] ?? '',
      email: data['email'] ?? '',
      photoUrl: data['photo_url'] ?? '',
      plan: data['plan'] ?? AppConstants.planTrial,
      questionsUsed: data['questions_used'] ?? 0,
      subscriptionExpiry: expiry,
      entitlements: parsedEntitlements,
    );
  }

  factory UserModel.fromFirestore(DocumentSnapshot doc) {
    final data = doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    return UserModel.fromMap(doc.id, data);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'photo_url': photoUrl,
        'plan': plan,
        'questions_used': questionsUsed,
        'subscription_expiry': subscriptionExpiry != null
            ? Timestamp.fromDate(subscriptionExpiry!)
            : null,
        'entitlements': entitlements.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toMap())),
      };

  Map<String, dynamic> toJsonMap() => {
        'name': name,
        'email': email,
        'photo_url': photoUrl,
        'plan': plan,
        'questions_used': questionsUsed,
        'subscription_expiry': subscriptionExpiry?.toIso8601String(),
        'entitlements': entitlements.map((k, v) => MapEntry(k, v.toJsonMap())),
      };

  UserModel copyWith({
    int? questionsUsed,
    String? plan,
    DateTime? subscriptionExpiry,
    Map<String, ModuleEntitlement>? entitlements,
  }) {
    return UserModel(
      uid: uid,
      name: name,
      email: email,
      photoUrl: photoUrl,
      plan: plan ?? this.plan,
      questionsUsed: questionsUsed ?? this.questionsUsed,
      subscriptionExpiry: subscriptionExpiry ?? this.subscriptionExpiry,
      entitlements: entitlements ?? this.entitlements,
    );
  }
}

/// Dilengkapi App Bar native yang bersih di bawah kamera notch/status bar,

class AgentWebviewScreen extends StatefulWidget {

  const AgentWebviewScreen({super.key, this.agent});

  /// Kebijakan keamanan URL: Hanya izinkan HTTPS pada ekosistem resmi Google NotebookLM
  static bool isAllowedNotebookUrl(Uri uri) => NotebookNavigation.allowed(uri);

class _AgentWebviewScreenState extends State<AgentWebviewScreen> {
  final AgentService _agentService = AgentService();
  final AuthService _authService = AuthService();

  final BookmarkService _bookmarkService = BookmarkService();

  InAppWebViewController? _webController;
  AgentModel? _agent;
  UserModel? _user;

  String? _agentUrl;
  bool _isLoadingUrl = true;
  bool _isWebViewLoading = true;
  bool _isPaywallRequired = false;
  String? _errorMessage;
  double _fontScale = 1.0;
  bool _isCopying = false;
  Timer? _readinessTimer;
  DateTime? _loadingStarted;
  int _readySamples = 0;
  bool _checkingReady = false;
  bool _hasCopied = false;

  bool _isExiting = false;
  bool _isGoingBack = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFontScale();
  }

  Future<void> _loadFontScale() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final value = prefs.getDouble('turath_font_zoom_level') ?? 1.0;
      final scale = value.isFinite ? value.clamp(0.85, 2.0).toDouble() : 1.0;
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _fontScale = scale);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _setFontScale(double scale) async {
    if (!mounted || !scale.isFinite) return;
    scale = scale.clamp(0.85, 2.0).toDouble();
    setState(() => _fontScale = scale);
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setDouble('turath_font_zoom_level', scale);
      if (!mounted) return;
      await _applyCurrentFontScale();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _applyCurrentFontScale() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    try {
      await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(
        source: 'if (typeof applyTurathFontScale === "function") { applyTurathFontScale($_fontScale); }',
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  DateTime? _lastCopiedToastAt;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    if (mounted) {
      AppSnackBar.clear(context);
    }
    final controller = _webController;
    _webController = null;
    if (controller != null) {
      unawaited(_stopWebView(controller));
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  static Future<void> _stopWebView(InAppWebViewController controller) async {
    try { await controller.stopLoading(); } catch (_) {}

            opacity: 0 !important;
            pointer-events: none !important;
            border: none !important;
          }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none !important; width: 0px !important; }
          html, body, * { scrollbar-width: none !important; }
          /* Padding atas dan bawah agar percakapan tidak terpotong */
          .chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container, .message-list, main {
            padding-top: 14px !important;
            padding-bottom: 24px !important;
            margin-top: 0px !important;
          }
        `;
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(style);
      }

      // 2. Font Scale Presisi
      window.applyTurathFontScale = function(value) {
        var scale = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(scale)) return;
        scale = Math.max(0.85, Math.min(2, scale));
        var fontStyle = document.getElementById('ot-font-scale-style');
        if (!fontStyle) {
          fontStyle = document.createElement('style');
          fontStyle.id = 'ot-font-scale-style';
          (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(fontStyle);
        }
        fontStyle.textContent = `
          .chat-panel-content, .chat-view, .conversation-container, .message-list, [role="article"] {
            font-size: ${Math.round(scale * 15)}px !important;
            line-height: 1.65 !important;
          }
          .chat-panel-content p, .chat-view p, [role="article"] p,
          .chat-panel-content span, .chat-view span, [role="article"] span,
          .chat-panel-content li, .chat-view li, [role="article"] li {
            font-size: inherit !important;
            line-height: inherit !important;
          }
          [lang="ar"], .arabic {
            font-size: ${Math.round(scale * 19)}px !important;
            line-height: 1.8 !important;
          }
        `;
      };
    })();
  """;

  static final _cloakScript = UserScript(
    source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript,
    injectionTime: UserScriptInjectionTime.AT_DOCUMENT_START,
    forMainFrameOnly: true,
  );

  bool? _lastIsDark;

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final currentIsDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    if (_lastIsDark != null && _lastIsDark != currentIsDark) {
      _webController?.setSettings(
        settings: InAppWebViewSettings(
          forceDark: currentIsDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
          forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy.PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
          algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
        ),
      );
      _applyThemeCss();
    }
    _lastIsDark = currentIsDark;

    if (_agent == null) {
      final rawArgs = ModalRoute.of(context)?.settings.arguments;
      if (rawArgs is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        _agent = rawArgs['agent'] as AgentModel?;
        _user = rawArgs['user'] as UserModel?;
      } else if (rawArgs is AgentModel) {
        _agent = rawArgs;
      }
      _agent ??= widget.agent ?? AgentModel.defaultAgents.first;
      _fetchAgentUrl();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _fetchAgentUrl() async {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    TelemetryService.instance.leaveBreadcrumb(
      'Membuka telaah modul: ${_agent?.id}',
      category: 'webview',
    );
    setState(() {
      _isLoadingUrl = true;
      _isWebViewLoading = true;
      _isPaywallRequired = false;
      _agentUrl = null;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    // 0. Cek apakah modul masih berstatus 'coming_soon'
    if (_agent != null && _agent!.isComingSoon) {
      setState(() {
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.preparingModule(_agent!.title);
      });
      return;
    }

    // 1. Pastikan profil pengguna termuat untuk verifikasi hak akses
    _user ??= await _authService.getCurrentUserModel();
    if (!mounted) return;

    // 2. Cek hak akses akun pengguna
    if (_user == null || !_user!.hasAccessToAgent(_agent!.id)) {
      setState(() {
        _isPaywallRequired = true;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.subscriptionRequiredFor(_agent!.title);
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    try {
      final url = await _agentService.getAgentUrl(_agent!.id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (url == null || url.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _errorMessage = AppCopy.moduleUnavailable;
          _isLoadingUrl = false;
        });
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _agentUrl = url;
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
      });
      _checkAndShowAdabDialog();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (e is AgentAccessException && (e.code == 'permission-denied' || e.code == 'unauthenticated')) {
        setState(() {
          _errorMessage = e.message;
          _isPaywallRequired = true;
          _isLoadingUrl = false;
        });
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _errorMessage = e is AgentAccessException
            ? e.message
            : AppCopy.studyNotLoadedYet;
        _isPaywallRequired = false;
        _isLoadingUrl = false;
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _detectGoogleAccessDenied() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    try {
      final res = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: """
        (function() {
          var bodyText = document.body ? (document.body.innerText || '') : '';
          var href = window.location.href || '';
          if (href.includes('signin/v2/denied') ||
              href.includes('access_denied') ||
              bodyText.includes('You need access') || 
              bodyText.includes('You do not have access') || 
              bodyText.includes('Request access') ||
              bodyText.includes('Anda memerlukan akses') ||
              bodyText.includes('Minta akses') ||
              bodyText.includes('Anda tidak memiliki akses') ||
              bodyText.includes('beralih ke akun yang memiliki akses') ||
              document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Request access"]') !== null ||
              document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Minta akses"]') !== null ||
              document.querySelector('.auth-error') !== null) {
            return 'DENIED';
          }
          return 'OK';
        })();
      """);
      if (res == 'DENIED' && mounted) {
        TelemetryService.instance.reportError(
          'Google 403 Access Denied on NotebookLM WebView',
          null,
          context: 'webview_access_denied_403',
          severity: 'warning',
          extra: {
            'agentId': _agent?.id ?? '',
            'agentTitle': _agent?.title ?? '',
            'userEmail': _user?.email ?? '',
          },
        );
        setState(() {
          _isPaywallRequired = true;
          _isLoadingUrl = false;
          _isWebViewLoading = false;
          _errorMessage = AppCopy.accessUnavailableFor(_agent?.title ?? AppCopy.studySpace);
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _applyHideScript() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    try {
      await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: _turatsMasterScript + notebookUiScript);
      await _applyThemeCss();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _applyThemeCss() async {
    if (_webController == null) return;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    try {
      final themeScript = '''
        (function() {
          try {
            var isDark = $isDark;
            // 1. Standar W3C color-scheme meta tag
            var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="color-scheme"]');
            if (!meta) {
              meta = document.createElement('meta');
              meta.name = 'color-scheme';
              (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(meta);
            }
            meta.content = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';

            // 2. Sinkronkan class Google Material / NotebookLM tema gelap
            if (document.documentElement) {
              document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark-theme', isDark);
              document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
              document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
              document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
            }
            if (document.body) {
              document.body.classList.toggle('dark-theme', isDark);
              document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
              document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
            }

            // 3. Pastikan latar belakang dasar & elemen internal selaras tanpa flash putih
            var canvasStyleId = 'ot-theme-canvas-style';
            var styleEl = document.getElementById(canvasStyleId);
            if (!styleEl) {
              styleEl = document.createElement('style');
              styleEl.id = canvasStyleId;
              (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(styleEl);
            }
            if (isDark) {
              styleEl.textContent = `
                html, body, [role="main"], mat-sidenav-content, mat-sidenav-container,
                .chat-container, .chat-viewport, .to-user-container, .message-content,
                .rendered-markdown, .query-container, .response-container,
                table, tr, td, th, mat-card, .mat-mdc-card, app-chat-message, app-chat-response,
                .chat-message-container, .notebook-content, .scrollable-content,
                .sources-panel, .studio-panel, div.content-container {
                  background-color: #0E0E10 !important;
                  color: #E4E4E7 !important;
                }
                table, th, td {
                  border-color: #27272A !important;
                }
                a {
                  color: #A1A1AA !important;
                }
              `;
            } else {
              styleEl.textContent = 'html, body { background-color: #FFFFFF !important; color: #18181B !important; }';
            }
          } catch(e) {}
        })();
      ''';
      await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: themeScript);
      await _applyCurrentFontScale();
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _saveCopiedAnswer(String text, String ownerUid) async {
    text = text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || text.length > 200000 || _authService.currentUser?.uid != ownerUid) return;
    final agent = _agent;
    if (agent == null) return;
    await _bookmarkService.addBookmark(copiedAnswerBookmark(text, agent), userId: ownerUid);
  }

  Future<void> _copyAnswerToClipboard() async {
    if (_webController == null || _isCopying) return;
    setState(() => _isCopying = true);
    try {
      final result = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.latest() : ""');
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noAnswerToCopy);
        return;
      }
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _hasCopied = true);
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.answerCopied);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.copyFailed);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isCopying = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveAnswerToBookmarks() async {
    if (_webController == null || _isCopying) return;
    final uid = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null) return;
    setState(() => _isCopying = true);
    try {
      final result = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.latest() : ""');
      final text = result is String ? result.trim() : '';
      if (text.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) AppSnackBar.warning(context, AppCopy.noAnswerToSave);
        return;
      }
      await _saveCopiedAnswer(text, uid);
      if (mounted) {
        AppSnackBar.success(context, AppCopy.savedSuccess);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.saveFailed);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isCopying = false);
    }
  }


  void _startReadinessCheck() {
    _readinessTimer?.cancel();
    _loadingStarted = DateTime.now();
    _readySamples = 0;
    _readinessTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), (_) => _checkReady());
  }

  Future<void> _checkReady() async {
    if (_checkingReady || _webController == null || !mounted) return;
    _checkingReady = true;
    try {
      final url = await _webController!.getUrl();
      final isLogin = url?.host == 'accounts.google.com' || url?.host == 'accounts.youtube.com' || url?.host == 'consent.google.com';
      final result = await _webController!.evaluateJavascript(source: 'window.otNotebook ? window.otNotebook.ready() : false');
      _readySamples = result == true ? _readySamples + 1 : 0;
      if (!mounted) return;
      final elapsedMs = _loadingStarted != null ? DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inMilliseconds : 0;
      if (isLogin || (_readySamples >= 7 && elapsedMs >= 6500)) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        setState(() => _isWebViewLoading = false);
      } else if (DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inSeconds >= 45) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        setState(() {
          _isWebViewLoading = false;
          _errorMessage = AppCopy.studyNotLoadedYet;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted && _loadingStarted != null && DateTime.now().difference(_loadingStarted!).inSeconds >= 45) {
        _readinessTimer?.cancel();
        setState(() { _isWebViewLoading = false; _errorMessage = AppCopy.cannotLoad; });
      }
    } finally { _checkingReady = false; }
  }

  Future<void> _handleBackPress() async {
    if (!mounted || _isGoingBack) return;
    _isGoingBack = true;
    setState(() => _isExiting = true);
    // Beri jeda 1 frame agar solid canvas overlay ter-render menutupi SurfaceView WebView
    // sehingga transisi pop route halus tanpa tearing/glitch putih di Android
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 40));
    try {
      await _webController?.stopLoading();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (mounted) {
      AppSnackBar.clear(context);
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }
  }

  bool _isNavigatingToSubscription = false;

  Future<void> _navigateToSubscription() async {
    if (_isNavigatingToSubscription) return;
    _isNavigatingToSubscription = true;
    try {
      final currentUser = _user ?? AuthService().cachedCurrentUser;
      if (!mounted) return;
      await NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
        context,
        AppRoutes.subscription,
        arguments: {
          'agent': _agent,
          'user': currentUser,
        },
      );
      if (!mounted) return;
      final refreshedUser = await AuthService().getCurrentUserModel();
      if (mounted && refreshedUser != null) {
        setState(() {
          _user = refreshedUser;
        });
        if (_isPaywallRequired && refreshedUser.hasAccessToAgent(_agent?.id ?? '')) {
          _fetchAgentUrl();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isNavigatingToSubscription = false);
      } else {
        _isNavigatingToSubscription = false;
      }
    }
  }



  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final canvas = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final surfaceSubtle = OTColors.surfaceSubtle(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return PopScope(
      canPop: false,
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
        if (didPop) return;
        _handleBackPress();
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: canvas,
        appBar: AppBar(
          toolbarHeight: 56,
          elevation: 0,
          scrolledUnderElevation: 0,
          backgroundColor: canvas,
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary, size: 22),
            tooltip: 'Kembali',
            onPressed: _handleBackPress,
          ),
          titleSpacing: 0,
          title: Text(
            _agent?.title ?? AppCopy.studySpace,
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            if (_user != null && _user!.plan == 'trial')
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 4),
                child: Center(
                  child: InkWell(
                    onTap: _navigateToSubscription,
                    borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: surfaceSubtle,
                        borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                        border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, size: 12, color: accent),
                          const SizedBox(width: 3),
                          Text(
                            '${_user!.questionsRemaining}',
                            style: OTTypography.caption(color: textPrimary).copyWith(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, color: textPrimary, size: 21),
              tooltip: AppCopy.referenceBooks,
              onPressed: () => showResearchLibrary(context, agent: _agent),
            ),
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.more_horiz_rounded, color: textPrimary, size: 22),
              tooltip: AppCopy.studyOptions,
              onPressed: _showOverflowMenu,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: OTSpacing.xs),
          ],
        ),
        body: SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              // ── 1. WebView Layer (Safe Below App Bar) ──
              if (_agentUrl != null)
                Container(
                  color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF0E0E10) : const Color(0xFFFFFFFF),
                  child: InAppWebView(
                    initialUrlRequest: URLRequest(url: WebUri(_agentUrl!)),
                    initialUserScripts: UnmodifiableListView<UserScript>([_cloakScript]),
                    initialSettings: InAppWebViewSettings(
                      userAgent: AppConstants.chromeMobileUserAgent,
                      javaScriptEnabled: true,
                      domStorageEnabled: true,
                      databaseEnabled: true,
                      sharedCookiesEnabled: true,
                      thirdPartyCookiesEnabled: true,
                      cacheEnabled: true,
                      clearCache: false,
                      clearSessionCache: false,
                      useHybridComposition: true,
                      mixedContentMode: MixedContentMode.MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW,
                      allowFileAccess: false,
                      allowContentAccess: false,
                      javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically: false,
                      useShouldOverrideUrlLoading: true,
                      supportZoom: true,
                      builtInZoomControls: true,
                      displayZoomControls: false,
                      mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture: false,
                      allowsInlineMediaPlayback: true,
                      forceDark: isDark ? ForceDark.ON : ForceDark.OFF,
                      forceDarkStrategy: ForceDarkStrategy.PREFER_WEB_THEME_OVER_USER_AGENT_DARKENING,
                      algorithmicDarkeningAllowed: true,
                      transparentBackground: false,
                    ),
                onWebViewCreated: (controller) {
                  _webController = controller;
                  final ownerUid = _authService.currentUser?.uid;
                  controller.addJavaScriptHandler(handlerName: 'otCopiedAnswer', callback: (args) async {
                    final url = await controller.getUrl();
                    if (ownerUid == null || url?.scheme != 'https' || !['notebooklm.google.com', 'notebook.google.com'].contains(url?.host) || args.isEmpty || args.first is! String) return false;
                    try {
                      final text = (args.first as String).trim();
                      if (text.isEmpty || text.length > 200000) return false;
                      final now = DateTime.now();
                      if (_lastCopiedToastAt != null &&
                          now.difference(_lastCopiedToastAt!) <
                              const Duration(milliseconds: 3500)) {
                        return true;
                      }
                      _lastCopiedToastAt = now;

                      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
                      if (context.mounted) {
                        AppSnackBar.success(
                          context,
                          AppCopy.answerCopied,
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2500),
                          action: SnackBarAction(
                            label: 'Simpan',
                            textColor: const Color(0xFF34D399),
                            onPressed: () => unawaited(_saveCopiedAnswer(text, ownerUid)),
                          ),
                        );
                      }
                      return true;
                    } catch (_) {
                      if (context.mounted) AppSnackBar.error(context, AppCopy.saveFailed);
                      return false;
                    }
                  });
                  _startReadinessCheck();
                },
                onLoadStart: (controller, url) {
                  if (mounted) setState(() => _isWebViewLoading = true);
                  _startReadinessCheck();
                },
                onPermissionRequest: (controller, request) async => PermissionResponse(
                  resources: request.resources, action: PermissionResponseAction.DENY,
                ),
                shouldOverrideUrlLoading: (controller, navigationAction) async {
                  final uri = navigationAction.request.url;
                  return uri != null && NotebookNavigation.allowed(uri)
                    ? NavigationActionPolicy.ALLOW : NavigationActionPolicy.CANCEL;
                },
                onLoadStop: (controller, url) async {
                  await _applyHideScript();
                  await _applyCurrentFontScale();
                  await _detectGoogleAccessDenied();
                  await _checkReady();
                },
                onProgressChanged: (controller, progress) async {
                  if (progress >= 25) {
                    await _applyHideScript();
                    await _detectGoogleAccessDenied();
                  }
                  if (progress >= 45) {
                    await _detectGoogleAccessDenied();

                  }
                },
                onReceivedError: (controller, request, error) {
                  if (request.isForMainFrame == true) {
                    TelemetryService.instance.reportError(
                      'WebView Main Frame Error: ${error.description} (code ${error.type})',
                      null,
                      context: 'webview_main_frame_error',
                      severity: 'error',
                      extra: {
                        'agentId': _agent?.id ?? '',
                        'url': request.url.toString(),
                      },
                    );
                  }
                  if (mounted && (request.isForMainFrame == true)) {
                    setState(() {
                      _isWebViewLoading = false;
                      _errorMessage = AppCopy.cannotLoad;
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),

            // ── Loading Indicator Screen (Unified Three Dots Minimal Pulse) ──
            if (_isLoadingUrl || (_isWebViewLoading && _errorMessage == null))
              Positioned.fill(
                child: AppLoader.fullscreen(
                  title: _agent?.title ?? AppCopy.openStudy,
                  subtitle: AppCopy.loadingReferences,
                  onCancel: _handleBackPress,
                ),
              ),

            // ── 2. Error State Screen (Unified AppErrorState) ──
            if (_errorMessage != null && !_isLoadingUrl)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: Container(
                  color: canvas,
                  child: AppErrorState(
                    title: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? AppCopy.subscriptionRequiredTitle
                        : AppCopy.cannotLoadStudy,
                    message: _errorMessage!,
                    icon: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? Icons.workspace_premium_rounded
                        : Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                    onRetry: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? _navigateToSubscription
                        : _fetchAgentUrl,
                    retryLabel: _isPaywallRequired
                        ? AppCopy.viewSubscription
                        : AppCopy.tryAgain,
                    onBack: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    backLabel: AppCopy.backToHome,
                  ),
                ),
              ),

            // ── 3. Solid Exit Overlay (Mencegah glitch/tearing SurfaceView Android saat pop) ──
            if (_isExiting)
              Positioned.fill(
                child: Container(
                  color: canvas,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _checkAndShowAdabDialog() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final hasSeen = prefs.getBool('has_acknowledged_adab_talaqqi') ?? false;
      if (!hasSeen && mounted) {
        await _showAdabTalaqqiDialog();
        await prefs.setBool('has_acknowledged_adab_talaqqi', true);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _showAdabTalaqqiDialog() async {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = isDark ? AppTheme.surfaceCardDark : AppTheme.surfaceCardLight;
    final border = isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.borderLight;
    final textPrimary = isDark ? AppTheme.textPrimaryDark : AppTheme.textPrimaryLight;
    final textSecondary = isDark ? AppTheme.textSecondaryDark : AppTheme.textSecondaryLight;

    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: true,
      builder: (dialogCtx) {
        return Dialog(
          backgroundColor: surface,
          insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(AppTheme.radiusCard),
            side: BorderSide(color: border, width: 1.0),
          ),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 24, 22, 20),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDark ? AppTheme.borderDark : AppTheme.pillSecondaryBgLight,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      ),
                      child: Icon(
                        Icons.verified_outlined,
                        size: 20,
                        color: textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        AppCopy.adabDialogTitle,

  void _showFontScalePicker() {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);

    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: surface,
            borderRadius: OTRadius.sheetBorder,
            border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
          ),
          child: SafeArea(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 16),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Center(
                    child: Container(
                      width: 36,
                      height: 4,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: border,
                        borderRadius: OTRadius.chipBorder,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(
                    AppCopy.studyOptions,
                    style: OTTypography.corpusTitle(color: textPrimary).copyWith(fontSize: 17),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    'Sesuaikan ukuran huruf percakapan agar nyaman dibaca.',
                    style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Kecil (85%)', scale: 0.85, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Standar (100%)', scale: 1.0, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Sedang (120%)', scale: 1.20, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Besar (140%)', scale: 1.40, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Sangat besar (165%)', scale: 1.65, isDark: isDark),
                  _buildScaleOption(ctx, label: 'Maksimal (200%)', scale: 2.00, isDark: isDark),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildScaleOption(
    BuildContext ctx, {
    required String label,
    required double scale,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    final isSelected = (_fontScale - scale).abs() < 0.05;
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final accent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return ListTile(
      dense: true,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      leading: Icon(
        Icons.text_fields_rounded,
        size: (18 * scale).clamp(16.0, 24.0),
        color: isSelected ? accent : textSecondary,
      ),
      title: Text(
        label,
        style: OTTypography.body(color: isSelected ? accent : textPrimary).copyWith(
          fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
        ),
      ),
      trailing: isSelected
          ? Icon(Icons.check_rounded, color: accent, size: 20)
          : null,
      onTap: () {
        _setFontScale(scale);
        Navigator.pop(ctx);
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';

import '../core/app_copy.dart';
import '../core/navigation_guard.dart';

/// Halaman Katalog Kitab (Full-Screen Route).
/// Mendukung 2.226 Kitab Induk lintas 6 disiplin ilmu kanonikal dengan pencarian Arab toleran harakat,
/// filter hierarki disiplin (القسم), abad keilmuan, dan kartu kitab minimalis bergaya turath.
class BookCatalogScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final AgentModel? agent;
  final String? initialQuery;

  const BookCatalogScreen({
    super.key,
    this.agent,
    this.initialQuery,
  });

  @override
  State<BookCatalogScreen> createState() => _BookCatalogScreenState();
}

class _BookCatalogScreenState extends State<BookCatalogScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final CanonicalLibraryService _service = CanonicalLibraryService.instance;
  Timer? _debounce;

  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _allBooks;
  List<CanonicalBookPresentation>? _filteredBooks;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;

  String? _selectedSection;
  String? _selectedEra;
  String? _selectedType;
  String? _selectedCentury;
  String _searchQuery = '';

  List<String> _availableSections = [];
  bool _hasEras = false;
  bool _hasTypes = false;

  final List<String> _eras = [
    'Mutaqaddimin',
    'Ashab Al-Wujuh',
    'Muta\'akhkhirin',
  ];

  final List<String> _types = [
    'Asal Mazhab',
    'Matan',
    'Syarah',
    'Hasyiyah',
  ];

  final List<String> _centuries = [
    'Salaf (≤ 300 H)',
    'Mutaqaddimin (301-600 H)',
    'Muta\'akhkhirin (601-1100 H)',
    'Mu\'ashir (> 1100 H)',
  ];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.initialQuery != null && widget.initialQuery!.isNotEmpty) {
      _searchCtrl.text = widget.initialQuery!;
      _searchQuery = widget.initialQuery!;
    }
    _loadCatalog();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _debounce?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadCatalog() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      final List<CanonicalBookPresentation> books;
      if (widget.agent != null) {
        books = await _service.loadCatalogForAgent(widget.agent!);
      } else {
        books = await _service.loadSyafiiCatalog();
      }

      final Set<String> rawSections = {};
      bool hasEras = false;
      bool hasTypes = false;

      for (final b in books) {
        if (b.sectionArabic != null && b.sectionArabic!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          rawSections.add(b.sectionArabic!.trim());
        }
        if (b.reviewedEraLabel != null && b.reviewedEraLabel!.isNotEmpty) {
          hasEras = true;
        }
        if (b.reviewedTypeLabel != null && b.reviewedTypeLabel!.isNotEmpty) {
          hasTypes = true;
        }
      }

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _allBooks = books;
        _availableSections = rawSections.toList()..sort();
        _hasEras = hasEras;
        _hasTypes = hasTypes;
        _isLoading = false;
        _applyFilters();
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
        _errorMessage = AppCopy.catalogLoadFailed;
      });
    }
  }

  void _onSearchChanged(String val) {
    if (_debounce?.isActive ?? false) _debounce!.cancel();
    _debounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 180), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _searchQuery = val.trim();
          _applyFilters();
        });
      }
    });
  }

  void _applyFilters() {
    if (_allBooks == null) return;
    _filteredBooks = _service.filterBooks(
      _allBooks!,
      _searchQuery,
      sectionFilter: _selectedSection,
      eraFilter: _selectedEra,
      typeFilter: _selectedType,
      centuryFilter: _selectedCentury,
    );
  }

  void _clearFilters() {
    _searchCtrl.clear();
    setState(() {
      _searchQuery = '';
      _selectedSection = null;
      _selectedEra = null;
      _selectedType = null;
      _selectedCentury = null;
      _applyFilters();
    });
  }

  bool get _hasActiveFilters =>
      _searchQuery.isNotEmpty ||
      _selectedSection != null ||
      _selectedEra != null ||
      _selectedType != null ||
      _selectedCentury != null;

  void _openBookDetail(CanonicalBookPresentation book) {
    NavigationGuard.safePushNamed(
      context,
      AppRoutes.bookDetail,
      arguments: book,
    );
  }

  String _formatNumber(int number) {
    return number.toString().replaceAllMapped(
          RegExp(r'(\d{1,3})(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))'),
          (Match m) => '${m[1]}.',
        );
  }

  String _cleanSectionLabel(String full) {
    final match = RegExp(r'\((.*?)\)').firstMatch(full);
    if (match != null && match.group(1) != null) {
      return match.group(1)!.trim();
    }
    return full;
  }

  String _resolveSubtitle() {
    if (widget.agent != null) {
      if (_allBooks != null && _allBooks!.isNotEmpty) {
        return '${_formatNumber(_allBooks!.length)} Kitab ${widget.agent!.title}';
      }
      return widget.agent!.title;
    }
    if (_allBooks != null && _allBooks!.isNotEmpty) {
      return '${_formatNumber(_allBooks!.length)} Kitab Mazhab Syafi\'i';
    }
    return '87 Kitab Mazhab Syafi\'i';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final surface = OTColors.surface(isDark);
    final background = OTColors.canvas(isDark);
    final border = OTColors.border(isDark);
    final textPrimary = OTColors.textPrimary(isDark);
    final textSecondary = OTColors.textSecondary(isDark);
    final primaryAccent = OTColors.accent(isDark);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: background,
        surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded, color: textPrimary),
          tooltip: 'Kembali',
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        ),
        title: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              AppCopy.referenceBooks,
              style: OTTypography.screenTitle(color: textPrimary)
                  .copyWith(fontSize: 18),
            ),
            Text(
              _resolveSubtitle(),
              style: OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary)
                  .copyWith(fontSize: 11),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          if (_hasActiveFilters)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _clearFilters,
              child: Text(
                'Hapus filter',
                style: OTTypography.button(color: primaryAccent)
                    .copyWith(fontSize: 13),
              ),
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        top: false,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // ── SEARCH CONTAINER ──
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
                vertical: OTSpacing.sm,
              ),
              child: Container(
                height: 48,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: surface,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                  border: Border.all(color: border, width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20, color: textSecondary),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _searchCtrl,
                        onChanged: _onSearchChanged,
                        style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: 13.5, color: textPrimary),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Cari kitab, pengarang, atau penahkik…',
                          hintStyle: GoogleFonts.outfit(
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            color: textSecondary.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                          ),
                          border: InputBorder.none,
                          enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          focusedBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          disabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          errorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          focusedErrorBorder: InputBorder.none,
                          filled: false,
                          isDense: true,
                          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty)
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () {
                          _searchCtrl.clear();
                          setState(() {
                            _searchQuery = '';
                            _applyFilters();
                          });
                        },
                        child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                            size: 18, color: textSecondary),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // ── DYNAMIC HORIZONTAL FILTER CHIPS ──
            _buildFilterChipsBar(
              isDark: isDark,
              surface: surface,
              border: border,
              textPrimary: textPrimary,
              textSecondary: textSecondary,
              primaryAccent: primaryAccent,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: OTSpacing.sm),

            // ── RESULTS COUNT HEADER ──
            if (!_isLoading && _filteredBooks != null && _allBooks != null)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: OTSpacing.lg,
                  vertical: 4,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      'Menampilkan ${_formatNumber(_filteredBooks!.length)} dari ${_formatNumber(_allBooks!.length)} kitab',
                      style:
                          OTTypography.caption(color: textSecondary).copyWith(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    if (_selectedSection != null ||
                        _selectedEra != null ||
                        _selectedType != null ||
                        _selectedCentury != null)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: primaryAccent.withValues(
                              alpha: isDark ? 0.12 : 0.06),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          [
                            if (_selectedSection != null)
                              _cleanSectionLabel(_selectedSection!),
                            if (_selectedEra != null) _selectedEra!,
                            if (_selectedType != null) _selectedType!,
                            if (_selectedCentury != null) _selectedCentury!,
                          ].join(' · '),
                          style: OTTypography.caption(color: primaryAccent)
                              .copyWith(
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),

            // ── MAIN CONTENT LIST / EMPTY / ERROR / LOADING ──
            Expanded(

                isDark: isDark,

                primaryAccent: primaryAccent,
